9ea6ebf6fe123a99.description: We are seeking a friendly and efficient Food & Beverage Counter Attendant to join our dynamic team, responsible for providing exceptional customer service and ensuring smooth operations at the point of sale. This role involves accurately taking customer orders, preparing beverages and light snacks, and maintaining a clean and organized work environment. If you are a motivated individual with a passion for hospitality and a commitment to excellence, we encourage you to apply. Key Responsibilities: * Greet customers warmly and assist them with menu selections. * Process orders accurately and efficiently using the POS system. * Prepare and serve beverages, coffee, and other food items according to established standards. * Handle cash and card transactions accurately. * Maintain cleanliness and organization of the counter area, equipment, and dining spaces. * Restock supplies as needed. * Address customer inquiries and concerns promptly and professionally.

9e1170b176195e7b.description: About the Role HUDSON is seeking a Mechanical Engineer / Senior Mechanical Engineer with specialized experience in Shutdown / Turnaround (SD/TA) projects. This full-time position is for an upcoming opportunity in Saudi Arabia, specifically in the Eastern Province (Al Jubail, Dammam) and Mecca Province (Rabigh). The role requires a professional with a strong background in mechanical maintenance and static equipment. Key Responsibilities Contribute to the planning, execution, maintenance, and coordination of Shutdown / Turnaround projects. Manage and oversee mechanical maintenance activities during SD/TA operations. Work with various mechanical static equipment, including heat exchangers, columns, pressure vessels, reactors, and pipelines. Ensure adherence to project schedules and operational requirements. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering. Minimum of 5-10 years of relevant experience in Mechanical Maintenance or Shutdown / Turnaround projects. Mandatory experience in Shutdown / Turnaround projects, preferably gained with a contractor. Demonstrated strong experience with mechanical static equipment, particularly heat exchangers, columns, pressure vessels, reactors, and pipelines. Proficiency in Primavera P6 is required. Good English communication skills are essential for this role. Application Requirements Candidates must clearly mention their relevant experience in their CV. This experience should be supported by verifiable experience certificates or letters. Only applicants with genuine and verifiable Shutdown / Turnaround experience will be considered for this opportunity. Compensation The salary for this position ranges from SAR 4,000 to SAR 7,000 Basic + FAT.

9e4303b05ba5dc55.description: About Hewlett Packard Enterprise Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) is a global edge-to-cloud company focused on advancing how people live and work. The company assists businesses in connecting, protecting, analyzing, and acting on their data and applications from edge to cloud, transforming insights into outcomes. HPE's culture values diverse backgrounds, flexibility, bold moves, and being a force for good. Role Overview: Strategy & Planning Lead This full-time, onsite Strategy & Planning Lead position is based in Riyadh. The role involves defining, managing, and evaluating business plans to ensure operational executability against strategic objectives. It requires leading and partnering with cross-functional teams to develop short-term business plans and supporting data-driven models. The Strategy & Planning Lead will prepare comprehensive implementation tactics, including execution plans, resource allocation, follow-up guidelines, assessment, and process accountabilities. Key Responsibilities Develop recommendations from complex data and business analyses, formulating them into actionable business plans. Drive the construction of highly innovative statistical and financial models to analyze new aspects of business performance. Establish metrics to measure business performance and recommend strategies to address performance gaps. Lead complex, time-sensitive market research projects and identify compelling trends and opportunities for business leaders. Staff and manage cross-functional teams across all business planning activities. Drive all aspects of priority projects and make final team decisions. Develop business plans and proactively identify new opportunities in partnership with client business leaders. Develop and drive comprehensive business plan recommendations based on analysis, emerging trends, and experience. Identify or develop cutting-edge analytical tools, models, and methods for key business decisions. Counsel business leaders, recommend approaches for executing high-level strategies, and develop creative solutions. Required Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this role should possess over 10 years of relevant experience. The position requires unique mastery and recognized authority on relevant subject matter knowledge, including technologies, theories, and techniques. The individual will contribute to the development of innovative principles and ideas, successfully operate in complex disciplines, and provide highly innovative solutions. This role leads large, cross-division functional teams or projects that affect the organization's long-term goals and objectives. Leadership and Strategic Impact The Strategy & Planning Lead may participate in cross-division, multi-function teams and provides mentoring and guidance to lower-level employees. This role routinely exercises independent judgment in developing methods, techniques, and criteria for achieving objectives, develops strategy, and sets functional policy and direction. The individual acts as a functional manager within their area of expertise but does not manage other employees as a primary job function. Responsibilities include ensuring business activities are aligned with stated plans among different stakeholders, setting business metrics, evaluating actual performance, and making recommendations to business leaders on performance target achievement. The role also develops data-driven analyses to optimize resources and ensure business plans translate into financial value. Accessibility at HPE HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. Should you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request via the provided secure form.

9e89039d9c357d5d.description: About the Role ACWA is seeking a Corporate Social & Welfare Manager to enhance labor rights and worker welfare across its international project portfolio. This full-time position is based in Makkah, specifically in Jeddah or Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role involves providing corporate oversight of labor practices within construction contractor workforces and driving the implementation of established frameworks. The Corporate Social & Welfare Manager will report to the Global Head of Environmental & Social. Role Context and Focus This is a senior specialist position with global reach, focusing on the welfare of workers engaged through construction contractors. The manager will work closely with regional and project E&S teams, EPC contractors, and corporate stakeholders to ensure international labor standards and lender requirements are effectively translated into on-the-ground practices. Key areas include responsible recruitment, working conditions, accommodation, human rights, and access to effective grievance mechanisms. The role also involves representing ACWA in discussions with lenders and investors. Key Responsibilities Oversee the implementation of corporate labor rights and worker welfare frameworks across projects. Engage with lenders and investors, demonstrate social compliance, and lead responses to labor and welfare concerns. Support project teams in identifying labor risks, implementing corrective actions, and verifying improvements. Assess contractor and subcontractor practices covering recruitment, employment conditions, worker accommodation, and welfare facilities. Strengthen monitoring and reporting systems to provide clear evidence of performance against lender requirements. Guide project teams on workforce grievance mechanisms, human rights risks, and prevention of gender-based violence and harassment. Build capability through practical guidance and training for E&S teams, relevant employees, and contractors. Collaborate with HR, Legal, and Compliance to address complex labor and welfare matters. Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of practical experience applying international labor standards and lender requirements, including relevant IFC Performance Standards, ILO standards, and development finance institution frameworks. Demonstrated experience engaging directly with lenders, responding to due diligence or monitoring findings, and delivering corrective actions. Strong understanding of contractor workforce risks, responsible recruitment, working conditions, and worker accommodation. Experience implementing social or labor management frameworks across multiple projects or countries. Ability to influence project leaders and contractors, constructively challenge gaps, and secure action without direct reporting authority. Willingness to travel internationally to project sites. Experience within an EPC contractor, energy developer, specialist consultancy, or international financial institution is valuable. Work Environment This role offers an opportunity to improve worker welfare across an international energy and water project portfolio. It combines practical project engagement with corporate influence and direct lender interaction. ACWA welcomes applications from internationally experienced professionals open to being based in Saudi Arabia.

9eec3c95bd8c097e.description: About KEENFINITY KEENFINITY is a globally leading provider of innovative and professional security and communication solutions, with over 4,000 employees across more than 50 countries. The company focuses on securing, connecting, and amplifying important moments through technology. KEENFINITY fosters a work environment built on trust, appreciation, and accountability, encouraging a customer-focused approach and strong team spirit. Inside Sales Internship, Telecommunication KEENFINITY is seeking a motivated and enthusiastic Inside Sales Intern in Telecommunication for its IQSIGHT division in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This internship, intended for Saudi Nationals and recent Telecommunication Engineering graduates, offers hands-on experience in B2B sales, CRM management, lead generation, and sales operations. The intern will support the sales team in generating new business opportunities, nurturing leads, and maintaining customer relationships, working alongside experienced sales professionals. Key Responsibilities Research and identify prospective customers across target industries. Generate and qualify sales leads through phone calls, emails, LinkedIn, and other outreach channels. Schedule meetings and product demonstrations for the sales team. Maintain accurate customer and prospect information in the CRM system. Follow up with potential customers to understand their requirements and nurture leads. Assist in preparing sales presentations, proposals, quotations, and reports. Support sales campaigns and promotional activities. Collaborate with the marketing and customer success teams to improve lead conversion. Track daily, weekly, and monthly sales activities and prepare performance reports. Stay updated on company products, industry trends, and competitor activities. Internship Benefits Practical experience in inside sales and business development. Exposure to CRM systems and modern sales tools. Mentorship from experienced sales professionals. Opportunity to build professional communication and negotiation skills. Certificate of Internship (subject to successful completion). Potential opportunity for a full-time role based on performance. Learning and development opportunities. Professional mentoring and networking exposure. Flexible working environment (based on company policy). Candidate Requirements This internship is open to Saudi Nationals, with a preference for recent Telecommunication Engineering graduates. Candidates should be motivated and enthusiastic, with 0-1 years of experience. Company Culture KEENFINITY is committed to shaping a smarter, more connected world through technology. The company values diverse backgrounds, ideas, and experiences, fostering an environment where everyone is respected, valued, and encouraged to be their authentic self. KEENFINITY is dedicated to growing, learning, and celebrating success as one team.

9e3ba4906c4b481c.description: About Air Products Qudra and BHIG Air Products Qudra is a joint venture that reimagines possibilities through the collective experience and motivation of its people. The company focuses on creating solutions that support various industries, from space exploration to healthcare and the construction of world-scale production facilities. BHIG—Blue Hydrogen Industrial Gases—is a regional development and investment joint venture between Saudi Aramco and Air Products Qudra, leveraging the combined strengths of both entities to drive industrial innovation and operational excellence across Saudi Arabia and the region. BHIG is committed to supporting clean energy goals through low-carbon hydrogen production. Role Summary: Assistant Site Manager The Assistant Site Manager will be based in Al Jubail and is responsible for managing and supervising the operations of a facility that includes an Air Separation Plant, a Hydrogen Steam Methane Reformer, a CO2 unit, compression systems, a Steam Turbine Generator, and all associated ancillary and utility equipment, along with a merchant facility and pipeline network. This full-time role requires 10 years of experience and reports directly to the Site Manager. Key Responsibilities Support the Site Manager in supervising operations staff, including shift supervisors and operators. Ensure daily operational targets are achieved and maintain safe and reliable site operations by interfacing with Maintenance and Engineering teams. Provide and maintain a safe work environment, demonstrating leadership in company and industry safe work processes. Ensure adherence to company HSSE policy and procedures, and meet all environmental regulatory requirements. Provide technical direction and guidance for troubleshooting, maintenance, repair, and testing activities. Manage plant production efficiently based on data-driven decisions to meet safety and reliability targets. Ensure the safety of all operations and maintenance personnel through the BHIG Basic Safety Practice program. Meet customer satisfaction targets for safety, reliability, product quality, and supply flexibility. Verify and approve SAP notifications with accurate basic data and participate in pre-work visits with Maintenance and Contractors. Participate in preparing maintenance or process shutdowns and turnarounds, including scope definition and prioritization. Manage and organize regular equipment testing and routine preventive maintenance. Release work permits, ensure all precautions are fulfilled, and maximize safe work permit practices. Conduct risk assessments and participate in unusual operational or maintenance activities. Provide coaching and motivation to the operations team to achieve operational excellence. Lead or participate in incident investigations and Root Cause Analysis, implementing sustainable corrective actions. Act as the Single Point of Contact for internal facility issues, coordinating internal resources. Qualifications and Experience 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Proven coordination experience in a multi-team environment, including operations, engineering, and maintenance. Strong leadership, interpersonal, and teamwork skills with effective communication abilities across all organizational levels and externally. Ability to foster a 'one team' environment. Capability to communicate and manage customer interactions daily. Extensive technical knowledge in operations, engineering, and maintenance activities. Understanding of local environmental and health and safety requirements. Work Environment This is a full-time position located in Al Jubail, requiring active participation in managing and supervising a complex industrial facility. The role involves close collaboration with various internal teams, including engineering and maintenance, and external stakeholders to ensure operational excellence and customer satisfaction. Application Information Candidates meeting the specified qualifications are encouraged to apply for this role to contribute to BHIG's commitment to industrial innovation and clean energy goals.

9e692f9708af3872.description: About the Role Le Méridien Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Restaurant Manager I to oversee daily restaurant operations in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves managing restaurant, bar, and room service functions, focusing on guest and employee satisfaction, and optimizing financial performance. The role requires 2-5 years of experience in the food and beverage industry. Key Responsibilities Supervise and manage daily restaurant, bar/lounge, and room service operations, ensuring adherence to service and sanitation standards. Assist with menu planning and maintain high sanitation standards across all food and beverage areas. Support servers and hosts on the floor during peak meal periods to ensure smooth service delivery. Review staffing levels to meet guest service needs, operational requirements, and financial objectives. Identify and implement training needs for the team, ensuring continuous improvement in knowledge and skills. Ensure compliance with all food and beverage policies, standards, procedures, and applicable laws and regulations, including food handling, sanitation, and liquor laws. Leadership and Team Development Lead by example, demonstrating honesty, integrity, and sound financial decision-making. Foster mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members. Coach, mentor, and guide employees to enhance their performance and professional development. Set clear goals and expectations for the team, prioritizing tasks effectively. Provide guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring progress. Ensure fair and equitable treatment of employees and strive to improve employee retention. Guest Service Excellence Ensure exceptional customer service, managing daily operations to meet and exceed guest expectations. Act as a guest service role model, creating a positive atmosphere and handling guest problems and complaints effectively. Gather feedback from guests on food and beverage quality, service levels, and overall satisfaction to drive continuous improvement. Manage service delivery from arrival to departure, including greeting, order taking, food and beverage delivery, special requests, and cashiering. Qualifications and Experience High school diploma or GED with 4 years of experience in food and beverage, culinary, or a related professional area. Alternatively, a 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or a related major, with 2 years of experience in food and beverage, culinary, or a related professional area. Additional Responsibilities Communicate effectively with supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates through various channels. Analyze information and evaluate results to identify optimal solutions and resolve operational issues. Oversee daily shift operations in the absence of the Assistant Restaurant Manager. Manage financial aspects of the department, including purchasing and invoicing.

9ec1425eb86851f9.description: About the Role Leylaty Group is seeking a Sous Chef (French Italian Mediterranean Cuisine) to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves assisting the Head Chef in managing kitchen operations, supervising staff, and ensuring the preparation of high-quality dishes. The position requires strong expertise in French or Italian Mediterranean cuisine, with a focus on authenticity, consistency, and presentation, contributing to maintaining kitchen efficiency, safety, and cleanliness. Key Responsibilities Assist the Head Chef in planning, developing, and executing menus, with a focus on French or Italian Mediterranean cuisine. Supervise kitchen staff and ensure proper food preparation, cooking techniques, and presentation standards. Monitor food quality, taste, and consistency to meet brand and culinary standards. Ensure adherence to all health, safety, and food hygiene regulations. Manage inventory, order supplies, and control food costs efficiently. Train and mentor kitchen staff on culinary techniques, recipes, and plating standards. Assist in scheduling staff shifts and managing daily kitchen operations. Maintain high levels of cleanliness and sanitation in all kitchen areas. Handle customer feedback, special dietary requests, and complaints when required. Support the Head Chef in fostering a positive, disciplined, and efficient kitchen environment. Qualifications and Experience Proven experience of 5-10 years as a Sous Chef or in a similar senior kitchen role. Strong hands-on experience in French or Italian Mediterranean cuisine is mandatory. A culinary degree or equivalent professional certification is preferred. In-depth knowledge of culinary techniques, food safety, and sanitation standards. Required Skills Strong leadership, communication, and team management skills. Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced, high-volume kitchen environment. Creativity, attention to detail, and passion for Mediterranean culinary arts. Work Environment The Sous Chef will operate within a dynamic kitchen environment, supporting the Head Chef in all aspects of culinary operations. The role demands a commitment to maintaining high standards of quality, safety, and efficiency in a fast-paced setting. Application Process Further details regarding the application process and salary will be disclosed upon inquiry.

9e507e4125c4f490.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مصرف الراجحي عن استشاري مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقه في المنطقة الغربية، بمدينة جدة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى عرض وبيع المنتجات والخدمات المصرفية للعملاء، مع الحفاظ على أعلى مستويات الجودة والاحترافية في الخدمة المقدمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال طلبات بيع المنتجات المصرفية ومتابعة إدخالها وتنفيذها على الأنظمة المعتمدة. مساعدة العملاء في فتح الحسابات، استيفاء المستندات المطلوبة، وإدخال البيانات والتوقيعات في النظام، وطلب تعميد مدير العمليات. ترحيل العقود والحسابات عبر البريد إلى مركز المعلومات وعلى نظام إدارة المستندات (DMS). الترحيب بالعملاء عند دخول الفرع وتقديم الخدمة المطلوبة لهم. مساعدة العملاء في تعبئة النماذج اللازمة عند الحاجة. توجيه العملاء لإتمام معاملاتهم بشكل صحيح، وشرح كيفية تنفيذ العمليات المتاحة عبر أجهزة الصراف الآلي والقنوات الإلكترونية الأخرى. توجيه العملاء إلى الموظف المختص حسب طبيعة استفسارهم أو طلبهم. الاستجابة السريعة لمعالجة مشاكل العملاء وتلبية طلباتهم وفقاً لإجراءات وتعليمات العمل، والمتابعة مع مراقب الفرع لحل المشاكل. استلام طلبات بطاقات الصراف الآلي، إدخالها في النظام، طباعة البطاقات الفورية، وتسليم البطاقات المجددة للعملاء. استقبال طلبات تحديث بيانات العملاء. استلام طلبات إغلاق الحسابات وتعديل بياناتها، وتسليمها لمدير العمليات لإدخالها في النظام. استقبال العملاء الموكلين، استكمال بيانات نموذج التوكيل، مطابقة التوقيع، إدخاله في النظام، وطلب تعميد مدير العمليات. استيفاء الأوامر المستديمة للعملاء، إنشاء وتنشيط العضويات، وتحويلها لمدير العمليات لاستكمال إجراءات تنفيذها. التعامل مع طلبات تغيير التوقيع وطلبات تحريك الحسابات. إدخال المطالبات المتعلقة بالصراف الآلي ونقاط البيع في نظام مطالبات بطاقات الصراف الآلي. استقبال مشاكل العملاء وتحويلها لمدير العمليات للعمل على حلها. الاستعلام عن البطاقات الائتمانية وبطاقات الصراف الآلي المسحوبة من الصراف الآلي بالفرع، وتوجيه العميل لاستلامها من كبير الصرافين. تزويد العملاء بالمنشورات التعريفية بالمنتجات. رفع بلاغات الاشتباه في غسل الأموال وحالات الاحتيال، والإبلاغ عن الحالات المخالفة للأنظمة والتعليمات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 1 إلى 5 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة والتعامل باحترافية. مهارات تواصل قوية وفعالة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مصرف الراجحي في مدينة جدة بالمنطقة الغربية، ويوفر بيئة عمل داعمة تهدف إلى تحقيق الأهداف المصرفية وتقديم أفضل الخدمات للعملاء. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: غير معلن. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة ضمن فريق مصرف الراجحي.

9e7b5d59155994a6.description: About the Role ArcelorMittal Tubular Products Al-Jubail is seeking an Accountant Profitability and Cost Performance to join their team in Al Jubail, Eastern region. This full-time role is responsible for supporting profitability reporting, manufacturing cost analysis, variance analysis, intercompany costing support, and dashboard preparation activities for the company's subsidiaries and affiliated entities. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Purpose and Context The Accountant, Profitability & Cost Performance, supports the Lead in generating accurate and timely analytical reports. This involves extracting, validating, and analyzing SAP and operational data across subsidiaries to provide visibility into product profitability, manufacturing cost performance, subsidiary operational performance, intercompany cost and margin analysis, sales backlog profitability, Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ), and operational cost drivers. The role is key to ensuring reporting standardization, data consistency, and analytical alignment with corporate reporting requirements. Key Responsibilities Support the preparation of monthly profitability reports for subsidiaries using SAP CO-PA and related systems. Prepare profitability dashboards and analytical reports by subsidiary/entity, customer, sales order, product category, and region. Analyze profitability performance across subsidiaries and identify major margin deviations. Support monthly manufacturing cost performance analysis against standard cost, budget, and prior periods. Analyze operational cost drivers, including material consumption, yield losses, utility consumption, cycle times, and rework & scrap. Prepare monthly backlog profitability reports and dashboards for subsidiary operations. Support the preparation of RFQ costing models and profitability simulations for subsidiary products and operations. Prepare monthly COPQ analysis and supporting reports for subsidiary operations. Develop and maintain dashboards using Excel, Power BI, SAP, or other reporting tools for subsidiary reporting requirements. Support internal and external audit activities by preparing required reports, reconciliations, and supporting schedules related to costing and profitability. Data Analysis and Reporting Validate data accuracy and reconcile subsidiary reporting outputs with Finance and Operations teams. Coordinate with subsidiary Operations, Production, and Finance teams to collect required operational and financial data. Prepare variance analysis reports with supporting explanations for subsidiary management and corporate finance teams. Ensure reporting visibility by customer, order, product, region, and segment for backlog profitability. Collect and validate operational and quality-related data from relevant stakeholders within subsidiaries for COPQ analysis. Extract and validate SAP data required for audit requests. Standardization and Compliance Assist in standardizing profitability reporting methodologies across subsidiaries. Support standardization of costing and performance reporting methodologies across subsidiaries. Support alignment of costing methodologies between subsidiaries and ArcelorMittal Tubular Products Al-Jubail. Ensure data consistency, reporting accuracy, and alignment with corporate reporting standards. Support compliance with corporate finance policies, costing procedures, and reporting standards across subsidiaries. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a relevant accounting or finance role. Proficiency in SAP CO-PA and other related systems. Experience with data extraction, validation, and analysis. Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify major margin deviations and operational cost drivers. Experience in developing and maintaining dashboards using tools like Excel and Power BI.

9e826777953a7304.description: About the Role HUDSON is seeking Field Service Engineers for contract positions across various cities in Saudi Arabia, including Al Ula, Medina, Al Jubail, Dammam, Rabigh, and Ras Tannurah. This role focuses on providing specialized field services for Medium Voltage (MV) Motors and/or Medium Voltage Variable Speed Drive (VSD/VFD) systems. Key Responsibilities Performing installation and commissioning of MV Motors. Conducting testing and startup procedures for MV Motor systems. Executing preventive and corrective maintenance on MV Motors and associated control/protection systems. Troubleshooting and repairing MV Motor systems. Commissioning and starting up MV VSD/VFD systems. Working with VSI / LCI drives and MV soft starters. Troubleshooting and repairing MV Variable Speed Drives. Performing preventive and corrective maintenance on MV Variable Speed Drives. Undertaking drive refurbishment and upgrades for industrial applications such as pumps, compressors, fans, and large motor systems. Required Experience and Qualifications Candidates must possess hands-on experience in one or both of the following areas: Medium Voltage Motors: Experience in installation, commissioning, testing, startup, preventive and corrective maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of MV motor systems and associated control/protection systems. Medium Voltage Variable Speed Drives: Experience in MV VSD/VFD commissioning and startup, VSI / LCI drives, MV soft starters, troubleshooting, repair, preventive and corrective maintenance, and drive refurbishment and upgrades for industrial applications. Prior field service or customer-site experience is preferred, along with the ability to work independently. Contract Details and Compensation This is a 1-year contract position, renewable based on performance and project needs. The salary is open and negotiable, dependent on the candidate's experience and technical expertise. Working Hours: 48 hours per week, 6 days per week. Overtime: Available and paid. Visa: Provided by the company. Joining Air Ticket: Provided by the company. Food, Accommodation & Transportation: Allowances will be provided in addition to the salary. GAMCA Medical: Cost will be paid or reimbursed by the company. Skill Test: Cost will be paid or reimbursed by the company.

9eeb9be184595cbe.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مخبز الخالدية النصف آلي عن عامل تعبئة رفوف للانضمام إلى فريقه في حائل. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان توفر المنتجات وترتيبها في مناطق العرض، مع الحفاظ على معايير النظافة والجودة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تعبئة الرفوف وأماكن العرض بالبضائع بشكل منتظم وفعال. الحفاظ على نظافة وترتيب البضائع في متاجر التجزئة والجملة. تطبيق إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية والعامة حسب الحاجة. الحفاظ على مستويات البضائع المتوفرة خلال ساعات العمل. إزالة المنتجات منتهية الصلاحية من الرفوف لضمان جودة المعروض. إرشاد العملاء إلى أماكن السلع عند الحاجة. ضبط درجات الحرارة المناسبة للسلع، خاصة تلك التي تتطلب تبريدًا أو تجميدًا. وضع الملصقات على المنتجات والتأكد من صحة المعلومات المدونة عليها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والالتزام بالتعليمات. الالتزام بمعايير النظافة والسلامة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة حائل، وتتطلب التواجد في مخبز الخالدية النصف آلي. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. معلومات إضافية نحن نبحث عن فرد ملتزم ومنظم للمساهمة في تقديم تجربة تسوق ممتازة لعملائنا من خلال الحفاظ على جودة وترتيب المنتجات المعروضة.

9e257982352fdf46.description: About The Company GE Vernova is an energy company focused on helping build, power, and decarbonize the world. Its work spans power generation, wind, electrification, and related technologies and services. Teams across the company contribute to energy systems that support customers, communities, and industries around the globe. Working at GE Vernova means collaborating with colleagues who bring varied technical and professional expertise to complex challenges across the energy value chain. The company’s purpose is reflected in its focus on reliability, innovation, and the energy transition. About The Role GE Vernova is seeking a motivated professional to contribute to work that supports the delivery of energy solutions for customers. This opportunity is suited to someone who brings sound judgment, a collaborative approach, and the ability to turn priorities into thoughtful, practical outcomes. The successful candidate will apply their experience and skills to assigned projects, operational activities, or customer engagements, depending on the team’s needs and the individual’s area of expertise. In this role, you will work with colleagues and stakeholders to understand objectives, coordinate activities, resolve challenges, and help deliver work safely and effectively. You will be expected to communicate clearly, manage competing priorities, and remain open to learning as technologies, customer needs, and business requirements evolve. The specific scope and technical requirements will depend on the team and position. Qualifications Candidates should have education, training, or relevant professional experience appropriate to the position and its area of focus. A degree, diploma, certification, or equivalent practical experience may be considered depending on the role. Applicants should be able to demonstrate clear written and verbal communication, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work constructively with colleagues from different functions and backgrounds. Successful candidates will bring a commitment to safety, quality, integrity, and responsible decision-making. They should be comfortable analyzing information, asking thoughtful questions, and adapting when priorities change. Familiarity with relevant tools, technologies, standards, or industry practices is an advantage where applicable. The ability to learn new systems and processes is important. Requirements for travel, work location, shift patterns, or other role-specific conditions will be shared as part of the hiring process. Responsibilities Contribute to assigned projects, services, or operational activities in line with established requirements and team priorities. Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to clarify objectives, share information, and support timely completion of work. Prepare, review, or maintain documentation and records with attention to accuracy, quality, and applicable procedures. Identify issues, risks, or opportunities for improvement and raise them with the appropriate colleagues. Use relevant data and feedback to inform decisions and help develop practical solutions. Follow safety, compliance, quality, and security requirements applicable to the role. Support customer-focused outcomes by responding professionally, honoring commitments, and helping teams address needs effectively. Participate in team meetings, training, and continuous-improvement activities, and share knowledge that can strengthen team performance. Benefits GE Vernova offers a competitive employment experience designed to support employees’ well-being and professional development. Depending on the position, location, and employment status, benefits may include health and wellness programs, retirement or savings plans, paid time off, learning resources, and opportunities to develop skills and pursue career growth. Eligibility, plan details, and available benefits vary by country and role and will be explained during the recruitment process. Equal Opportunity GE Vernova is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to legally protected characteristics, in accordance with applicable laws. The company is committed to providing a respectful and inclusive workplace and encourages qualified candidates with diverse backgrounds and experiences to apply. Reasonable accommodations are available for applicants who need assistance during the application or interview process.

9e362c18b8f66b67.description: About the Role Dar Al Riyadh is seeking an experienced Head of Architectural to lead and manage the architectural design department within its engineering consultancy. This full-time role is based in Riyadh and involves overseeing architectural projects from concept through detailed design and construction documentation. The successful candidate will ensure design excellence, technical compliance, and coordination with multidisciplinary teams, while adhering to project schedules and budgets. Key Responsibilities Lead the architectural department and oversee all architectural design activities across multiple projects. Review and approve concept designs, schematic designs, detailed designs, and construction documentation. Ensure design solutions meet client requirements, project objectives, quality standards, and applicable building codes. Establish and maintain architectural design standards, guidelines, and best practices. Provide technical direction and resolve complex architectural design challenges. Project Management and Delivery Oversight Oversee architectural project deliverables throughout all project stages. Monitor project progress, resource allocation, deadlines, and design quality. Ensure compliance with project specifications, contractual requirements, and applicable regulations. Identify design risks, technical issues, and potential project delays, implementing corrective actions when required. Support project managers in achieving project milestones and delivery targets. Team Leadership and Development Lead, mentor, and develop a team of architects, senior architects, and architectural designers. Allocate resources and workloads based on project priorities and team capabilities. Conduct technical reviews and performance evaluations. Identify training needs and promote continuous professional development. Foster collaboration, accountability, and technical excellence within the department. Technical Coordination and BIM Implementation Oversee the implementation and effective use of BIM workflows, Revit, and related design technologies. Ensure architectural models and drawings are accurate, coordinated, and compliant with project BIM requirements. Coordinate with structural, MEP, infrastructure, and other engineering disciplines to resolve design clashes and interface issues. Review BIM deliverables, model quality, drawing packages, and design documentation. Promote efficient digital design practices and continuous improvement in design coordination. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 15 years of experience in architectural design, with a significant portion in a leadership role. Strong leadership skills and extensive architectural design experience. Ability to manage teams, engage with clients, and deliver high-quality design solutions. Proficiency in local regulations and international standards relevant to architectural design. Experience in client and stakeholder management, acting as a primary architectural point of contact. Demonstrated ability to ensure quality assurance and regulatory compliance for architectural designs.

9e83cb3dd87c6f4b.description: The Role The Clinical Dietitian is responsible for planning, delivering and evaluating nutrition care services for patients across assigned clinics. You will provide Medical Nutrition Therapy, monitor clinical nutrition parameters, support food service quality and contribute to quality improvement initiatives. You will report to the Clinic Manager and work closely with the Head of Nutrition Care, physicians, nurses and the wider multidisciplinary team What You Will Do Deliver Medical Nutrition Therapy tailored to hemodialysis patients with different backgrounds, age groups and medical conditions. Implement the Nutrition Care Process, including screening, assessment, diagnosis, intervention, counselling, monitoring and evaluation. Identify and manage nutrition-related conditions including malnutrition, protein-energy wasting (PEW), sarcopenia, obesity, diabetes and other chronic conditions. Monitor clinical, biochemical and nutritional parameters and develop individualised nutrition care plans. Utilise digital tools, AI-enabled technologies and body composition assessment devices where available to support nutritional assessment, monitoring and clinical decision-making. Maintain accurate documentation, including Monthly Care Plans, nutritional assessments, follow-ups and referrals. Participate in nutrition audits, quality improvement initiatives and monitoring of nutrition outcome indicators. Collaborate effectively with the multidisciplinary team to support comprehensive patient care. Support the orientation, education and development of dietitians, interns and colleagues. Stay updated on renal nutrition, malnutrition, sarcopenia, digital health and emerging technologies in clinical nutrition Desired Candidate Profile You are clinically precise, patient-focused and forward-thinking. You understand that nutrition in dialysis is complex and requires both strong technical knowledge and effective patient communication. You will be well-suited to this role if you: Deliver evidence-based nutrition care with accuracy and genuine patient focus. Communicate effectively with patients and healthcare professionals. Recognise nutritional risk early and take appropriate action. Are comfortable using digital tools and open to AI and technology-enabled clinical practice. Take initiative in quality improvement and continuous learning. Work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team. What we need: Bachelor's degree in Clinical Nutrition. Master's degree is an advantage. Valid SCFHS classification/registration as a Clinical Dietitian Specialist. Fluent in Arabic and English, spoken and written. Proficient in MS Office and basic computer systems. Clinical dietetics experience in a hospital or healthcare setting. What you need to be able to do: Bachelor's degree in Clinical Nutrition. Master's degree is an advantage. Valid SCFHS classification/registration as a Clinical Dietitian Specialist. Fluent in Arabic and English, spoken and written. Proficient in MS Office and basic computer systems. Clinical dietetics experience in a hospital or healthcare setting. What gives you an edge: Experience in renal nutrition, diabetes or chronic disease management. Knowledge of malnutrition, PEW and sarcopenia. Experience with body composition analysis, nutrition assessment technologies or digital clinical tools. Familiarity with HACCP and foodservice management. Experience with nutrition outcome indicators, research or quality improvement projects.

9e93343f23d7433d.description: About the Role Orient Insurance KSA is seeking a Risk Engineer Assistant Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing and monitoring risk survey operations to ensure compliance with property and engineering insurance regulations and standards. The Assistant Manager will oversee the Risk Engineering team, delivering accurate and timely risk assessments. Job Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to manage, monitor, and control risk survey operations within Orient Insurance KSA. This includes ensuring adherence to applicable property and engineering insurance regulations and standards, planning survey schedules, reviewing technical reports, and supporting claims reviews. The Assistant Manager will supervise the Risk Engineering team to ensure the delivery of accurate, timely, and commercially useful risk assessments. Key Responsibilities Plan, allocate, and monitor commercial and personal risk surveys across major locations in KSA. Conduct site surveys, assess risk information, and collect appropriate photographic and technical evidence. Prepare and review detailed risk survey reports, presentations, and recommendations for underwriters. Evaluate maximum and estimated loss exposures and advise on risk improvement requirements. Advise clients, brokers, and internal stakeholders on practical measures to reduce the likelihood and impact of future claims. Review the quality of survey reports and recommendations, follow up on implementation, and assign quality grades after improvements are completed. Support General Claims in reviewing loss adjuster reports, technical errors, and required evidence for claim decisions. Supervise, coach, and develop engineers and processors; maintain current technical knowledge on regulations, fire protection, hazardous materials, and industry standards. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in risk engineering or a related field within the insurance industry. Internal and External Relationships This role requires extensive communication and collaboration with various internal departments and external stakeholders. Internal: General Underwriting, General Claims, Reinsurance, Legal, Compliance, Internal Audit, Business Development, Human Resources, and Administration. External: Clients and site management, brokers, loss adjusters, regulators, health and safety inspectors, fire officers, maintenance teams, and specialist engineers. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

9eac8cc52a182c29.description: About the Role Informa PLC is seeking a Head of Marketing - LIONS Riyadh - Arabic Speaker to lead the brand, audience, and go-to-market strategy for LIONS Riyadh. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and requires 5-10 years of experience. The role involves establishing the Festival as a key creative industry platform in the region and a recognized part of the global LIONS community. About Tahaluf and LIONS Riyadh Tahaluf, a joint venture between Informa PLC, the Saudi Federation for Cybersecurity, Programming and Drones (SAFCSP), and the Events Investment Fund (EIF), is a B2B live and on-demand events organizer in Saudi Arabia. LIONS Riyadh, launched by Tahaluf in partnership with LIONS and Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Media, is a distinct Festival within the global LIONS community. It aims to amplify Middle Eastern creativity globally, showcasing regional talent and connecting creative industries with leading networks and brands. The inaugural three-day Festival will take place in Riyadh from 6–8 December 2027. Key Responsibilities Develop value propositions and go-to-market strategies in collaboration with commercial leads. Oversee the delivery of marketing campaigns aligned with business objectives, timelines, and budgets. Manage a cross-functional marketing team, fostering creativity and enthusiasm. Build awareness, consideration, and demand for LIONS Riyadh across Saudi Arabia, the GCC, and priority international markets. Drive qualified registrations, ticket sales, and attendance from priority audience segments. Ensure all campaigns reflect the LIONS brand, tone, and creative standards, maximizing impact across paid, owned, and earned channels. Deliver strong digital engagement, conversion, and return on marketing investment. Build an active year-round community around the LIONS Riyadh brand via content marketing. Drive effective collaboration across Marketing, Content, PR, Commercial, Creative, and LIONS teams. Act as a change management ambassador, demonstrating a positive and constructive attitude towards challenges. Qualifications and Requirements 5-10 years of experience in marketing leadership, with a track record of commercial collaboration. Proficiency in Arabic is required. A distinctive combination of brand thinking, creative judgment, audience insight, and commercial marketing expertise. Ability to build desire around a premium global brand while ensuring cultural relevance to Saudi Arabia and the wider Middle East. Analytical and data-oriented with experience in testing and optimization, combined with creative flair and attention to detail. Extensive experience in digital marketing, content marketing, and marketing technology. Accustomed to delivering results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Ability to work closely with LIONS, Content, Creative, PR, Commercial, and Partnerships teams. Adaptable to differing market dynamics and capable of guiding marketers and steering campaign strategy accordingly. Team Leadership and Development Line manage senior marketers and specialists across various events, providing guidance, feedback, and inspiration. Build a high-performing, creatively ambitious marketing team capable of delivering to LIONS brand standards. Champion bold thinking, strong creative judgment, and audience-first marketing. Promote the adoption and optimization of marketing technology solutions and digital marketing. Ensure line reports have clear development roadmaps and the necessary skills and training. Data-Driven Strategy and Brand Management Monitor campaign performance, analyze trends, and use data insights to build effective campaigns. Develop a deep understanding of LIONS Riyadh audience segments, motivations, and behaviors across key markets. Track brand awareness, consideration, and perception to ensure relevance and desirability in the market. Oversee the annual marketing calendar and build integrated campaign plans across all channels. Ensure all LIONS Riyadh marketing is creatively distinctive, premium, and consistent with the global LIONS brand, with strong localization for Saudi and regional audiences.

9eea9bac3b828b8c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة السليمي المتحدة للمقاولات عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية، ومتابعة التنفيذ، وتشخيص الأعطال، وتطوير برامج الصيانة للمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. تطوير مخططات ومواصفات لخطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية وتحديد مساراتها. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية بدقة. معرفة جيدة بشبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال ووضع حلول للصيانة والإصلاح. مهارات في إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة. سيعمل المهندس الكهربائي ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة السليمي المتحدة للمقاولات، مما يوفر بيئة عمل داعمة للتطوير المهني. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة لم يتم الكشف عنه، وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى شركة مقاولات رائدة والمساهمة في مشاريعها الهندسية.

9e1815f29be98a1e.description: We are looking for qualified NDT Technicians specializing in Radiographic Testing Film Interpretation (RTFI), Penetrant Testing (PT), or Ultrasonic Testing (UT) to join our PED Division at Salama Engineering. The candidates will be responsible for conducting non-destructive testing and inspection of welds, pressure vessels, heat exchangers, and fabricated components to ensure compliance with applicable ASME codes, project specifications, and quality standards. Candidates should have relevant NDT certifications, hands-on experience in fabrication environments, and the ability to perform inspections, evaluate defects, prepare technical reports, and maintain inspection records in accordance with approved procedures and safety requirements. Key Responsibilities: Perform NDT inspections using RTFI, PT, or UT techniques on welds, pressure vessels, heat exchangers, and fabricated components. Identify, evaluate, and report surface and subsurface defects in accordance with approved inspection procedures. Ensure compliance with applicable ASME codes, project specifications, and quality standards. Prepare inspection reports and maintain accurate testing records and documentation. Verify inspection equipment calibration and ensure proper use of testing tools and materials. Coordinate with QC Inspectors, Welding Engineers, and fabrication teams to resolve inspection findings. Follow approved NDT procedures, quality control requirements, and workplace safety standards. Ensure inspection activities are completed within project timelines and meet customer requirements. Qualifications and Experience: Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or a relevant technical qualification; Higher Secondary Certificate may be accepted for PT Technician. Minimum 2–5 years of relevant experience in NDT inspection within pressure vessel, heat exchanger, or heavy fabrication industries. Valid certification in the relevant NDT method: RTFI, PT Level II, or UT Level II, preferably PCN or an equivalent recognized certification. Good knowledge of ASME Section V, applicable inspection standards, and project specifications. Hands-on experience in weld inspection, defect identification, and preparation of NDT reports. Ability to read technical drawings, follow approved inspection procedures, and maintain accurate documentation. Strong attention to detail, quality awareness, and commitment to workplace safety.

9e517c2669f4a65a.description: About the Role Al Futtaim Group is seeking an Electrical Technician for Al-Futtaim Automotive - BYD in KSA. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and focuses on advanced diagnostics and repair of vehicle electrical, electronic, and high-voltage systems across conventional, hybrid, and fully electric vehicles. Role Purpose and Context The Electrical Technician serves as the workshop's specialist for complex electrical faults, ECU programming, software updates, and ADAS calibration. As the automotive industry transitions towards electrified and software-driven vehicles, this position is critical for ensuring diagnostic accuracy, repair quality, and the safe handling of high-voltage systems. The role also supports overall workshop capability by assisting general technicians with complex cases and contributing to the team's technical knowledge development. Key Responsibilities Diagnose and repair complex electrical and electronic faults, including CAN bus systems, body control modules, infotainment systems, and powertrain electronics. Perform advanced fault tracing using OEM diagnostic tools, scan platforms, and electrical testing equipment. Execute ECU flashing, software updates, and control module programming in line with manufacturer guidelines. Carry out ADAS calibration, sensor alignment, key coding, and immobilizer programming as required. High-Voltage System Management Perform diagnostics, service, and repair of high-voltage (HV) systems in electric and hybrid vehicles. Conduct battery health checks, isolation testing, and inspection of inverters, electric motors, and HV wiring systems. Ensure correct handling, storage, and maintenance of HV batteries and related components. Maintain and calibrate HV diagnostic tools, including insulation testers, milliohm meters, and specialized equipment. Required Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience in vehicle electrical, electronic, and high-voltage systems. Demonstrated expertise in advanced diagnostics and repair across conventional, hybrid, and fully electric vehicles. Application Process This is a full-time position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

Key Responsibilities: Take responsibility for the architectural design and delivery of projects from concept through to construction documentation Translate concept designs into coordinated, buildable and well-detailed drawing packages Coordinate with structural, MEP, fa ade and landscape consultants to ensure a fully integrated design Prepare and review drawings, specifications, schedules and presentations to a high standard Ensure compliance with the Saudi Building Code, local authority regulations and relevant international standards Manage project deliverables and programmes, working closely with senior architects and project directors Liaise with clients, authorities, contractors and consultants to support smooth project delivery Guide and support junior architects and architectural assistants What s on Offer: Opportunity to work on prestigious, large-scale projects in one of the world s fastest-growing markets A design-led studio culture that values creativity and innovation Competitive salary package and benefits Clear career growth within a respected architectural practice If you are a passionate architect ready to take the next step in your career and make a significant impact on Riyadh s evolving skyline, we would love to hear from you. 9ed8651083713848.description: Job description: Position Overview: Reports To: Program Director Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Employment Type: Full Time Work Arrangement: On-site Application Deadline: 10 November 2026 Role Purpose: We are seeking an experienced Contracts Manager (E1) to lead contract management across DAR Engineering's large-scale projects in Riyadh. The role holds overall responsibility for the formation and administration of contracts and subcontracts, from pre-qualification and tendering through to performance monitoring, claims resolution and close-out, protecting the commercial and contractual interests of the project. The successful candidate will bring deep knowledge of engineering and construction contracting practices, sound commercial judgement and the leadership to manage a contracts team and influence senior stakeholders on complex, multi-discipline projects. Key Responsibilities: Hold overall responsibility for contract management on large-scale projects, safeguarding the contractual and commercial interests of the project. Lead the contracts team, including workload distribution, execution of work and personnel management. Manage the formation and administration of contracts and subcontracts, including pre-qualification, compilation of bid requests, receipt of bids, bid evaluation and award. Monitor contractor performance against contract requirements, and administer back charges where applicable. Administer and negotiate change orders, including pricing and assessment of cost and time impact. Manage claims and disputes, assessing entitlement, negotiating resolution and escalating where required. Draft and review contract documents, and advise project teams on contract law, obligations and risk. Oversee prime contract administration, and establish the execution office and field procedures and documents needed for a multi-discipline construction project. Prepare clear and effective contract correspondence and notices, and maintain complete contract records. Coordinate planning and scheduling inputs from a contractual perspective, including delay and extension of time matters. Ensure compliance with government and commercial procurement regulations, policies and procedures. Report on contract status, commercial risks and exposures to the Project Director and senior management. Education and Certifications: Bachelor's degree in Business, Quantity Surveying, Law, Engineering, Construction Management, Supply Chain Management or an equivalent degree from an accredited university, with preference for candidates educated in Western countries. Professional qualifications in contract management, quantity surveying or construction law (for example RICS, CIArb or FIDIC contract training) will be an advantage. Experience Requirements: Minimum 17 years of experience in contracts management, including overall responsibility for contract management on large-scale projects. Direct experience of managing workload distribution, execution of work and personnel management. Experience in the formation and administration of contracts and subcontracts: pre-qualification, compilation of bid requests, receipt of bids, bid evaluation, award, monitoring of contractor performance, back charges, and resolution of claims and disputes. Demonstrated experience in pricing, contract law, contract drafting, administration and negotiation of change orders, effective correspondence, planning and scheduling. Experience of working internationally on multi-discipline construction projects; prior experience in Saudi Arabia is preferred. Technical Knowledge: Technical and administrative knowledge of engineering and construction industry contracting practices, government and commercial procurement regulations and practices, policies, procedures and work practices. Thorough knowledge of prime contracts management administration, as well as (sub)contract formation and administration. Thorough knowledge of execution office and field procedures and documents relating to a multi-discipline construction project. Working knowledge of internationally used standard forms of contract, such as FIDIC. Skills and Competencies: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong negotiation skills and sound commercial judgement. Leadership and people management skills, with the ability to distribute workload and manage a team. Strong analytical skills, with demonstrated experience in pricing and commercial evaluation. Skilled in contract drafting, effective correspondence and accurate record keeping. Strong planning and scheduling skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities on large-scale projects. Working Hours: We support a healthy work-life balance through flexible working hours, allowing employees some flexibility in their daily start and finish times, while maintaining a structured working schedule of up to 48 hours per week. What We Offer: The chance to drive growth on landmark projects across Saudi Arabia and the GCC. A collaborative, supportive environment within a leading multidisciplinary consultancy. Competitive salary and benefits, including housing and transportation. Comprehensive healthcare coverage and wellness support. A team that genuinely encourages each other to succeed. A diverse, inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds come together under one shared vision. A culture that celebrates success, values innovation, and builds something bigger together. We believe great work happens as a team. We want people to come in with purpose and leave each day with a sense of accomplishment. 9ea9c72695f4e1da.description: About the Role Advanced Metals Company (AMCO) is seeking an Engineer II Product Engineering to join their team in Dammam, Eastern region. This full-time role focuses on executing product engineering, design development, and technical support for AMCO’s upstream Oil & Gas product portfolio. The Engineer II will independently develop and verify designs, drawings, calculations, BOMs, and technical documentation, while supporting customer inquiries and product applications. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Develop and modify designs for gate valves, hammer unions, OCTG products, API wellhead and pressure-control equipment, and wireline tools. Prepare and review engineering drawings, 3D models, calculations, BOMs, specifications, and Design Verification Reports within delegated authority. Perform design verification, material selection, tolerance evaluation, and value-engineering assessments in line with applicable requirements. Process engineering changes, controlled document updates, and product lifecycle records in the PLM or approved document-control system. Provide technical input for customer inquiries, quotations, bids, product applications, contract reviews, and sales-order feasibility assessments. Prepare technical clarifications, datasheets, catalogues, presentations, and troubleshooting guidance, escalating exceptions when required. Coordinate with Manufacturing on manufacturability, route cards, tooling, process instructions, assembly, and testing requirements. Support Procurement with material specifications, technical bid evaluations, vendor clarifications, and certification or traceability requirements. Work with Quality on ITPs, acceptance criteria, nonconformities, CAPA, root-cause analysis, and audit evidence. Apply API 6A, 16A, 16C, 5CT, and 5B requirements and relevant ASME, NACE, ISO, and customer specifications. Support API monogram, customer, internal, and external audits and maintain complete, current, and traceable engineering records. Identify design, quality, lead-time, and cost improvements and share lessons learned with engineering and operational teams. Accountabilities Accuracy, completeness, and timely delivery of assigned drawings, models, calculations, BOMs, specifications, and verification records. Compliance of assigned engineering outputs with approved design inputs, API standards, customer requirements, and document-control procedures. Effective technical support for quotations, customer inquiries, manufacturing, procurement, quality, and field-service requirements. Timely identification and escalation of design risk, nonconformity, feasibility constraints, technical deviations, and approval requirements. Maintaining traceable product data, engineering-change records, design files, and audit evidence. Contribution to measurable improvements in product reliability, manufacturability, quality, cost, and lead time. Qualifications and Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or a closely related engineering discipline. Industrial Design may be considered where supported by relevant product-engineering experience. Experience: 4–8 years of relevant experience in product engineering, design development, and technical support within an Oil & Gas manufacturing, service, or repair environment. Demonstrated experience independently delivering moderately complex engineering assignments and supporting API, customer, or quality audits. Technical Knowledge and Skills Strong knowledge of gate valves, hammer unions, OCTG products and connections, wellhead and pressure-control equipment, or wireline tools. Practical knowledge of API 6A, 16A, 16C, 5CT, and 5B, with awareness of ASME, NACE MR0175/ISO 15156, ISO, and customer requirements. Good understanding of CNC machining, welding, assembly, hydrostatic and gas testing, material selection, certification, and traceability. Strong proficiency in 3D CAD software such as SolidWorks or Inventor and familiarity with engineering calculation or FEA tools. Working knowledge of PLM, ERP/SAP, engineering change, and controlled-document workflows. Sound analytical, problem-solving, technical-writing, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to manage concurrent assignments, collaborate cross-functionally, work independently within delegated authority, and support junior engineers when required. Application Information The salary for this position will be commensurate with experience and qualifications, and will be disclosed during the interview process.

9ef68f8e9b68fe89.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة دار المعدات الطبية والعلمية عن فني مختبر طبي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إجراء الفحوصات المخبرية الدقيقة للعينات، والمساهمة في تقديم نتائج موثوقة لدعم التشخيص الطبي. تتطلب الوظيفة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، مما يجعلها فرصة مناسبة للخريجين الجدد أو ذوي الخبرة المحدودة في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تفقد وتشغيل وصيانة معدات حفظ وفحص العينات، وضبطها وفقاً لنوع الفحص المطلوب ومراقبة أدائها. دراسة طلبات الأطباء لتحديد الفحوصات المطلوبة، وسحب عينات الدم، واستلام عينات البول والبراز، مع تدوين بيانات المرضى عليها وحفظها بالطرق الصحيحة. تحضير العينات للفحص والزراعة، واختيار مواد الفحص بالكميات والمواصفات المطلوبة، وإجراء الفحوصات المختلفة بما في ذلك التحاليل الكيميائية والفيزيائية والمجهرية على العينات. استخراج وتوثيق نتائج الفحوصات، والتخلص من العينات بعد الانتهاء من التحاليل مع توثيق إجراءات الإتلاف. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المختبرات الطبية. القدرة على التعامل مع المعدات المخبرية وتشغيلها وصيانتها الأساسية. معرفة جيدة بأسس حفظ العينات وإجراءات السلامة المخبرية. المهارات والكفاءات الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في إجراء الفحوصات وتحليل النتائج. مهارات تنظيمية جيدة لتوثيق البيانات والتقارير. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والالتزام بالبروتوكولات المعيارية. بيئة العمل سيعمل فني المختبر الطبي في بيئة مختبرية متخصصة في الرياض، ضمن فريق شركة دار المعدات الطبية والعلمية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بالمعايير المهنية في بيئة عمل ديناميكية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في الرياض. سيتم الإفصاح عن تفاصيل الراتب خلال عملية التوظيف.

9e7c9eacf6a73d5c.description: About Salehiya Healthcare Salehiya Healthcare, established in 1964, is a leading Saudi Arabian company specializing in the distribution of pharmaceuticals, medical and laboratory equipment, diagnostics, medical disposables, and hospital and consumer supplies. The company has evolved with the health sector in Saudi Arabia, meeting the demands of a growing market. Salehiya Healthcare operates from its main bases in Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam, with additional branches across the Kingdom, supported by a workforce of over 1000 employees. The Role of Manager, Outbound Logistics Salehiya Healthcare is seeking a Manager, Outbound Logistics to lead and optimize all outbound logistics activities for the company and its affiliates. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and is critical for ensuring the efficient, compliant, and timely distribution of pharmaceutical, medical, and healthcare products across the Kingdom. The Manager will uphold cold-chain and quality standards, drive operational excellence, and contribute to Salehiya Healthcare’s mission through innovative, digital, and customized logistics solutions. This position plays a key part in delivering superior service to customers, partners, and healthcare providers. Lead outbound logistics projects, process improvements, automation initiatives, and innovation in cold-chain logistics to enhance efficiency and visibility. Monitor and improve maintenance, fuel consumption, and temperature calibration of the delivery fleet to prevent breakdowns. Oversee returns and recall processes, ensuring accurate collection by Delivery Representatives and processing by the Outbound Officer. Manage relationships with logistics partners, carriers, and third-party providers, ensuring alignment with service standards and SLAs. Demonstrated experience in managing outbound logistics operations, preferably within the healthcare or pharmaceutical distribution sector. The core values guiding Salehiya Healthcare's people are derived from its purpose to elevate the healthcare experience in the Kingdom.

We foster an inclusive culture that values diversity, supports professional development, and encourages collaboration across all levels. As a member of our TPMO leadership team, you will have the opportunity to influence key strategic decisions, drive meaningful change, and contribute to high-impact projects that shape the future of the region. Your expertise will foster a culture of continuous improvement through structured business analysis, scenario planning, and portfolio prioritization, ensuring alignment with broader Group objectives. Oversee the comprehensive annual and three-year business planning cycles, collaborating closely with cross-functional stakeholders to integrate financial and operational objectives. Maintain and continuously update the Strategic Initiatives Register, tracking progress, milestones, and benefit realization through to successful closure. Conduct detailed operational efficiency analyses, identify areas for improvement, and develop robust business cases to support enhancement initiatives. Design and manage a strategic performance framework that supports rigorous monitoring and evaluation, producing insightful Quarterly Business Review analyses to inform strategic decisions. Deliver comprehensive business analyses including options appraisal, scenario modeling, and benchmarking against industry best practices to guide strategic choices. Prepare executive-level reports, papers, and dynamic presentations that effectively translate data and analyses into clear strategic decisions for senior leadership. Ensure continuous alignment of DevCo Operations strategy, business plans, and performance metrics with the overarching Group direction and interrelated DevCo functions. Required Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a related discipline is required. Advanced degrees or relevant certifications are advantageous. 7 to 10 years of progressive experience, with a minimum of 4 years focused on corporate strategy, business planning, performance management, business analysis, or management consulting, preferably within complex project delivery environments. Technical and Professional Skills Corporate Strategy and Strategic Planning: Expert proficiency to support strategic development and drive implementation with agility. Business Analysis and Options Appraisal: Expert capability in dissecting business problems and evaluating alternatives to recommend sound solutions. Business Planning and Portfolio Prioritisation: Advanced skills to align projects and initiatives with strategic priorities effectively. KPI Framework Design and Performance Management: Advanced expertise to develop meaningful performance metrics that drive accountability and excellence. Executive Communication and Presentation Design: Expert-level skill in articulating complex information succinctly and convincingly to senior stakeholders. Additional Requirements Excellent command of written and spoken English with strong executive writing and communication skills; proficiency in Arabic is considered advantageous. Demonstrated ability to develop analytical models and deliver high-impact executive-grade presentations.
